column3: “At the time of the return of the year” is rendered “in the spring”; NASB supplies “to battle.” “The army of war” is rendered “the army,” and “destroyed” as “ravaged.”
“Weight of a talent” is rendered “to weigh a talent”; NASB supplies “placed.”
“Sawed with the saw” is rendered “cut them with saws.” The last tool is rendered “axes”; the Hebrew has “saws” again, and NASB follows the reading in 2 Samuel 12:31. “Of iron” is not rendered.
“A battle arose” is rendered “war broke out,” and “those born of the Rephaites” as “the descendants of the giants.”
“The wood of his spear” is rendered “the shaft of whose spear.”

“His digits were six and six, twenty-four” is filled out as “twenty-four fingers and toes, six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot.” “Born to the Rapha” is rendered “descended from the giants.”
“Born to the Rapha” is rendered “descended from the giants.”
